title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Hazardous-Waste Fee Reimbursement on Waiting-Period Re-decisions
content:
**Clause.** On a waiting-period re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the hazardous-waste fee reimbursed follows the system repaired. The fee and the labor lines are read from the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Covered repair | Customer-pay labor on the repair order | Hazardous-waste fee reimbursed |
|---|---|---|
| Air-conditioning or cooling system | all of it on the covered concern line | the fee charged, in full |
| Air-conditioning or cooling system | some on other concern lines | the fee times the covered concern line's labor charge over all customer-pay labor charged on the repair order, rounded half up to the cent |
| Any other component group | — | none |

The covered concern line is the concern line carrying the repair order's diagnostic fee.

**Cases (hypothetical fee of 7.40).**
- An air-conditioning compressor repair, with all labor on the covered line: 7.40.
- A cooling repair with 300.00 of covered labor out of 500.00 on the repair order: 7.40 times 300.00 over 500.00, which is 4.44.
- A steering repair: 0.00.
